## Not my favorite...
Curate is not built for a full-service catering business. They are trying but it's really not conducive to what is needed. The website is glitchy and slow, the only trainings are videos (who has time to watch videos?), their customer service bot is no use, and their wait times to talk to a human are growing longer everyday. The prior version, "Classic", took forever to get used to and they let a lot of their redeeming qualities slip through the cracks when transferring into "New Curate." It seems like everything requires a work around. Have you ever had to create your own invoices? Because I do! Some cool features but, honestly, I miss CaterXpert and THAT's saying something.
